projects.title: AI SaaS Platform
projects.description: Enterprise-grade AI platform serving 50,000+ users with real-time collaboration features
projects.longDescription: Built a comprehensive AI-powered SaaS platform from the ground up that enables teams to collaborate on machine learning projects. The platform handles real-time updates, complex data visualizations, and supports multiple AI model integrations.
projects.problem: Companies needed a unified platform to manage AI workflows without vendor lock-in
projects.approach: Microservices architecture with real-time sync, progressive enhancement, and edge computing
projects.challenges: Handling concurrent model training, optimizing WebSocket connections, managing GPU resources
projects.results: Reduced AI workflow time by 60%, achieved 99.9% uptime, scaled to 50K users in 6 months

projects.title: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: High-performance analytics dashboard processing 1M+ events per second
projects.longDescription: Developed a real-time analytics platform capable of ingesting, processing, and visualizing millions of events per second. Features include custom query builder, interactive visualizations, and automated alerting.
projects.problem: Marketing teams needed instant insights from massive data streams
projects.approach: Event-driven architecture with streaming pipelines and column-oriented database
projects.challenges: Real-time aggregations, memory optimization, handling data skew
projects.results: Enabled real-time decision making, reduced infrastructure costs by 40%, 10x faster queries

projects.title: E-Commerce Marketplace
projects.description: Multi-vendor marketplace with 10K+ sellers and $5M+ in transactions
projects.longDescription: Built a scalable marketplace platform connecting buyers and sellers with advanced search, recommendation engine, secure payments, and comprehensive seller tools.
projects.problem: Small businesses struggled with expensive marketplace fees and complex setup
projects.approach: Modular architecture with AI-powered recommendations and automated onboarding
projects.challenges: Payment reconciliation, fraud prevention, search relevance at scale
projects.results: Onboarded 10K sellers in 8 months, processed $5M+ transactions, 3.2% conversion rate

projects.title: Healthcare Management System
projects.description: HIPAA-compliant patient management system serving 200+ clinics
projects.longDescription: Created a comprehensive healthcare management platform with patient records, appointment scheduling, telemedicine, billing, and analytics—all HIPAA compliant.
projects.problem: Clinics needed affordable, compliant software with telemedicine capabilities
projects.approach: HIPAA-compliant cloud architecture with end-to-end encryption and audit logs
projects.challenges: HIPAA compliance, video call quality, offline support, data security
projects.results: Served 200+ clinics, 50K+ patients, 4.8/5 satisfaction, zero security breaches

projects.title: Social Media Analytics Tool
projects.description: Social media monitoring platform analyzing 10M+ posts daily
projects.longDescription: Developed a comprehensive social listening platform that tracks brand mentions, sentiment analysis, competitor analysis, and trend detection across major social platforms.
projects.problem: Brands needed real-time insights into social media conversations
projects.approach: NLP pipelines with sentiment analysis, entity recognition, and trend detection
projects.challenges: Multi-language support, real-time processing, API rate limits
projects.results: 92% sentiment accuracy, 25+ languages, helped brands respond 5x faster

projects.title: Developer Portfolio Builder
projects.description: No-code portfolio builder used by 5,000+ developers
projects.longDescription: Built a platform that lets developers create stunning portfolios without writing code. Features include drag-and-drop editor, GitHub integration, custom domains, and analytics.
projects.problem: Developers wanted beautiful portfolios but lacked design skills
projects.approach: Template-based system with smart GitHub integration and one-click deploy
projects.challenges: Template customization, GitHub API rate limits, performance optimization
projects.results: 5K+ users, 8K+ portfolios created, 4.7/5 rating, 80% completed in under 30 min
